checkpoint_training_corpus.warning: The released checkpoint is declared as the base multispecies MLM. The paper also reports a separate GUE-continued model, but the pinned Hugging Face object is not declared as that continued checkpoint.

GRCh38.p14_project_reference.evidence: Human reference sequence is included in the declared multispecies corpus, but the exact assembly accession and per-locus retained sequence inventory are not bound to the checkpoint.

GSE289173_reference_allele_windows.evidence: Human reference-like sequence was part of pretraining. Exact locus membership cannot be excluded and is not treated as clean merely because cohort labels were later released.

GSE289173_observed_variant_alleles.evidence: The corpus inventory does not establish whether any alternate human haplotypes were present among the multispecies genome records.

GSE289173_eQTL_ieQTL_effects.evidence: The checkpoint was released in 2023 and used unlabeled reference genomes; GSE289173 became public on 2025-02-12.

GUE_regulatory_tasks.evidence: The paper evaluated and separately continued DNABERT-2 on GUE training sets; the registered base checkpoint is not declared as the continued object.

task_data_gate.sealed_rule: No GSE289173 label, summary statistic, calibration target, layer choice, threshold, or hyperparameter may enter preprocessing, head fitting, or selection.
